note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide is written in my own words for this entry and cites its source beside it. No specific location, count or step is claimed unless the official description states it or the trophy list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles states the count.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing extra to do for it on its own. Treat the roadmap below as the real guide to it — story first, then the stranger strands, then activities and cleanup, with 100% completion last. The progress bar at the top of this page shows how close the platinum is.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this trophy comes naturally at the start of the game; just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission ends. Nothing here can be missed — it is the beginning of the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Play through the story missions in order; the chapter ends when its last mission is done, and the trophy pops then. No side content is needed for it — the story alone carries you there.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Keep playing the story missions in order after Chapter 1; the chapter ends when its last mission is done. Like the other chapter trophies, it cannot be missed — finishing the chapter is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Play through the story missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's last mission is complete. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. This is the last chapter before the finale, so play through its missions in order until the chapter closes. The trophy pops when the last mission of the chapter is done.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Play through all four chapters; the final mission unlocks at the end of the story, and completing it earns this gold trophy. If a mission fails, retry it — the trophy only needs one successful completion, and nothing in the description makes it a one-time chance.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so keep playing the main story in order until it appears, then finish it. The trophy pops when the mission ends successfully.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Keep playing the main story in order until this heist mission appears, then finish it. The trophy pops when the mission ends successfully.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Keep playing the main story in order until it appears, then finish it. The trophy pops when the mission ends successfully.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Keep playing the main story in order until it appears, then finish it. The trophy pops when the mission ends successfully.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Keep playing the main story in order until it appears, then finish it. The trophy pops when the mission ends successfully.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Keep playing the main story in order until it appears, then finish it. The trophy pops when the mission ends successfully.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own completion checklist, which counts story, missions, activities and collectibles together. This is a late-game trophy by design: finish the story, the stranger strands and the open-world activities first, and use the in-game completion stats to see what is left. It is the last big trophy before the platinum for most players.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's driving and riding tricks — jumps, near misses and the like — and the counter builds up across all of free roam, so it climbs as you play naturally. The description names no single place for them, so treat it as a long grind best done alongside everything else rather than in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The trophy list counts 9 activity types (count as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles): sample one of each — races, fishing, the shooting range, the arcade, drone races and the rest — rather than mastering any one of them. One try each is all it takes, so check the types off as you sample them.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
Activity-type count as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (the count PlayStation tracks, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles). Work through the range's challenges one by one and repeat any that fall short of gold; learn each challenge's layout before chasing the gold result. This is a skill trophy — expect to replay the harder challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
Challenge count as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in total (count as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles). Race at each location until you win there; a win at a location counts once, so move on after each victory. Drone handling takes practice, so learn a course before racing it for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
Location count as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races across the map and win 20 distinct ones — the same race won twice counts once, so keep moving to new races. Any race type the game offers counts toward the 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him in it; fishing is a timing and patience activity, so watch the line and reel in steadily rather than rushing. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Visit an arcade, pick any game, and play it through to its end. One full completion is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the strangers you meet across Leonida; work through his mission strand until its last mission, then finish it. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so check the map for stranger markers between story missions.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is one of the strangers you meet across Leonida; work through his mission strand until its last mission, then finish it. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so check the map for stranger markers between story missions.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy is one of the strangers you meet across Leonida; work through his mission strand until its last mission, then finish it. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so check the map for stranger markers between story missions.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. There are more stranger strands than 8, so you only need eight of them finished — pick the ones you enjoy and finish each strand to its last mission. This pairs naturally with the individual stranger-final trophies, which count toward the 8.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy is one of the strangers you meet across Leonida; work through his mission strand until its last mission, then finish it. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so check the map for stranger markers between story missions.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is one of the strangers you meet across Leonida; work through his mission strand until its last mission, then finish it. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so check the map for stranger markers between story missions.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find the meditation spots around the map and meditate at each one; the description gives no count, so the in-game map and completion stats are your checklist — this guide claims no number of spots. It is a calm, slow trophy: do it between louder activities.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt asks for one specific animal; follow his strand until the hunt is offered, then track and take down that animal. A unique animal is a one-off target, so take the shot carefully when you find it.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it, and three full sets earn the trophy. Collect as you explore — the description names no card locations, so no card spot is claimed here.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the game's photo and tagging activity; do it at 100 different spots around Leonida. The counter is per location, so keep moving to new places rather than repeating the same one.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's assorted open-world tasks; finish any 50 of them. They accumulate across everything you do, so this trophy usually pops during normal cleanup play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears. Pick a quiet part of the map to hide in, and do not pick up new heat while you wait.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner alongside, rob one shop, then immediately rob a second and a third — and do it without the wanted level dropping in between, so keep moving and keep the heat on. Plan a route past three close shops before you start.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicles — each new vehicle you get into counts toward the total. Try everything you see parked or driving by; variety, not speed, is what this trophy counts.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and take all five down before it ends. Pick a fight with a crowd, not a single target, and line the shots up before you trigger it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). The description is deliberately vague, so treat it as an airport stunt: get to VCIA, get into an aircraft, and take off without a schedule. No specific aircraft or runway is named in the description, so none is claimed here.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank and use it — the description's joke is the hint: find a Rhino and take it for a spin. Tanks attract attention, so expect a wanted level while you drive it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet and get out without any alarm or witness raising the alarm. Stealth is the whole trophy: if you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults in total and get away clean after each one. Plan the escape before the robbery — a fast vehicle waiting outside matters more than the vault itself.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck, rob it, and get away. One truck and one clean escape is all it takes.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the map until the whole state is uncovered. Drive the roads, visit the towns and the countryside — the in-game map shows what is still unexplored.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs illegal operations; rob one operation per gang. The description names no gang count, so work through the gangs you meet until every one has had an operation hit — this guide claims no number of gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and have a cocktail there. It is a quiet moment trophy — no combat, no timer, just the beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into a vehicle showroom and drive a car straight out through the front. It is a stunt with a clear shape: pick a showroom, pick a car, and go through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the bowling alley and bowl — follow through on the throw. One visit and one game is the shape of it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a story-moment trophy whose description gives no steps — it unlocks as the story's partnership reaches its peak. Keep playing the story; it comes when the moment does. This guide claims no mission name for it, because the description names none.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This trophy is tied to a story choice, and the description does not say which one — so it is the one trophy in this list flagged as possibly missable: a choice, once made, may not be offered again. Keep a manual save before major story decisions so you can return to them. That is the only missable flag in this guide, because it is the only description that implies a one-time choice.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description suggests a retry — something that works on the second attempt. If an activity or moment fails the first time, try it again; the trophy is about the second go landing.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A secret-moment trophy with a deliberately vague description — it unlocks when something strange happens in the world. Explore odd places and follow odd events; the trophy pops when the moment finds you. This guide claims no location for it, because the description names none.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving by, hit targets with a melee weapon hard enough to bowl them over. It is a driving-combat stunt: line up a pass, swing as you go by, and keep the speed up.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It is a slow economy trophy — keep laundering as the bills come in rather than saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — clothes, food, weapons, whatever you buy counts. It accumulates across the whole playthrough, so it usually pops during normal play.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property the game offers. Garages cost money, so save for them — and each one also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles from Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten vehicles and register each one to the Scooter Bros app. Any vehicle you drive can be registered, so register as you go rather than hunting ten at once.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
